dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh! Do you need a hand with anything? B—But never mind if you don't though!

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: I'd like to know as well... What are you doing here, Guy?

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Alright, I'm guarding the side gate of Mondstadt. As everyone knows, it's a gate that no one uses.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Mock me all you want. I know it's a pointless job.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: I've started training at the age of 8, learned swordsmanship at the age of 10, and become a squire at 16...

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: I'm the pride of the family, yet I'm tasked with such a job...

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: As a member of the Knights of Favonius, guarding the side gate is like Cat's Tail without Diona. There's no soul in it!

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: ...Anyway, have you bumped into any trouble? Any kind at all — let me see if I can help! I am a Knight of Favonius after all!

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Please do come to me when you need help...

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Well, forget it. You won't remember me anyway...
